new.s: Who won the First Battle of Tarain in 1191?
new.x: In the First Battle of Tarain (1191) Prithviraj Chauhan defeated Muhammad Ghori, who barely escaped. Ghori won the second battle in 1192.

new.s:
Match the following:
List-I (Battle)
A. First Tarain (1191)
B. Second Tarain (1192)
C. Chandawar (1194)
D. Kasahrada near Mount Abu (1178)
List-II (Result)
1. Muhammad Ghori defeated Jaichand
2. Prithviraj Chauhan defeated Muhammad Ghori
3. Mularaja II defeated Muhammad Ghori
4. Muhammad Ghori defeated Prithviraj Chauhan
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
new.x: Prithviraj won Tarain I (1191) and lost Tarain II (1192); Ghori beat Jaichand at Chandawar (1194); Mularaja II of Gujarat gave Ghori his first defeat in 1178.
new.angle: U0103 #1 Battle -> opponent + victor (APPSC PYQ y4e15ed23e09)

new.s: Who translated the Chachnama into Persian?

new.x: The Chachnama, the chronicle of the Arab conquest of Sindh, was translated into Persian by Muhammad Ali bin Abu Bakr Kufi.

new.s: Who is the author of Samarangana Sutradhara, a treatise on architecture?
new.x: Samarangana Sutradhara, on architecture and machines, was written by the Paramara king Bhoja.

new.s: Navasahasanka Charita of Padmagupta is a biography of which Paramara ruler?
new.x: Padmagupta (Parimala), court poet of the Paramaras, wrote Navasahasanka Charita about Sindhuraja, whose title was Navasahasanka.

new.s: Which work gives the earliest reference to the use of the magnetic compass in the Indian seas?

new.s: How many tarangas (books) does Kalhana's Rajatarangini have?
new.x: Kalhana's Rajatarangini ("River of Kings"), the 12th-century history of Kashmir, has 8 tarangas.

new.s: While playing which game did Qutbuddin Aibak die in 1210?
new.x: Aibak died at Lahore in 1210 after falling from his horse while playing chaugan (polo), a game brought to India by the Turks.
Aibak died at Lahore, his capital, in 1210 and was buried near Anarkali Bazaar there.
